title: Claim
description: A claim about a knowledge node. Claims are never treated as entities; conflicting claims coexist with their review state (docs/data/CLAIM_SCHEMA.md). Since minor 1.1 the review lifecycle (status) and evidence strength (confidence) are separate fields (ADR-016).

schema_version.description: 1.1 splits the formerly conflated status into status (review lifecycle) + confidence; writers target 1.1.

object.description: Object or value of the claim.

scope.description: Qualifier, e.g. 'as of 2025' or 'in superconducting platforms'.

status.description: Review lifecycle. Before minor 1.1 this field also carried confidence values; see ADR-016 for the mapping.

confidence.description: Evidence strength (PRD §6 confidence states), independent of the review lifecycle. Defaults to unverified when omitted.

review_state.description: Extraction-queue triage state (frozen by W2-06); distinct from the status lifecycle. Consolidation is a follow-up once apps migrate (ADR-016).
